item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
After finished the series Altered Carbon, for me was inevitable to associate the ornate amulet that contain the consciousness of Dr. Bright with the cortical stack that described in the series. Am I the only that thought that? I know that the series is from 2018 and the novel it was based is from 2002 while the article is from later 2008, and than mechanism associate is different (a magical/mystical jewelry in the SCP and a technological device in the series) but the idea is similar. I don’t have any critique to the article, I enjoyed a lot its reading, as fact I voted +1 for this and think is a well deserve piece of the Heritage Collection, but the fact that both ideas are similar is curious.

PS: If this post doesn’t apply here, please move to the correct place.

PS2: It’s not an issue of fanfics about another fiction franchise, or and forced comparison or relation, just a commentary about a curiosity. Also I know that the article has almost 10 years, and maybe exist other pieces of fictions that works this idea (about the binding the consciousness/soul from a person to an object)
